synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO published a PDPASA Forecast LOR1 for South Australia covering part of 29 July 2026, and then cancelled that Forecast LOR1 before 29 July arrived.

document_statements.quote: [2.] From 1700 hrs 29/07/2026 to 2230 hrs 29/07/2026. The forecast capacity reserve requirement is 400 MW. The minimum capacity reserve available is 379 MW.
The Forecast LOR1 condition in the SA region advised in AEMO Electricity Market Notice No. 144652 is cancelled at 1345 hrs 28/07/2026.
